source.paper: Bokelmann L, Nickel O, Maricic T, Paabo S, Meyer M, Borte S, Riesenberg S. Point-of-care bulk testing for SARS-CoV-2 by combining hybridization capture with improved colorimetric LAMP. Nature Communications 12, 1467 (2021). doi:10.1038/s41467-021-21627-0

source.field_notes: x,y = liquid centre as fractions of full-res width/height; r = radius (fraction of width) inside the coloured liquid. hole_r (optional, fraction of width) = central white glare/bubble; read the annulus hole_r..r. Extra optional fields: assay (CV1-6 = Orf1a primers, CV15-20 = N primers), sample (paper ID), ct (RT-qPCR E-gene Ct), paper_hue (the paper's own hue for that reaction, mean of its duplicate reads, degrees). paper_call uses the paper's 28.5 deg cut-off on paper_hue where the paper applies it. role 'other' = well whose content is not documented. Source Data column headers 'N gene'/'Orf1a' are swapped relative to Supp Tables 3-4 and the photo labels; this file follows the photos/Supp Tables.
source.well_reader_caution: Truth is the reference status (RT-qPCR or set status), never the LAMP colour; several known LAMP false negatives/positives are included on purpose.
